---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an idea or request enhancement details for this system
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement, planning
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm frustrated when I have to manually log in every morning..."

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Detail the visual interface or logic change.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Mockups / Wireframes**
If applicable, draw or write a simple ASCII/Mermaid mock representation of how you imagine the UI layout.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
